clauses.requirement: In the retro-reflector photometric test procedure (Annex 5 Part 1, para 1), if for the direction β1 = β2 = 0° and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

The retro-reflector photometric testing shall apply the definitions of Annex 5 Part 1 para 2 (basic definitions in para 2.3 of the Regulation; Figures A4-I to A4-III): reference centre C; illumination axis I; observation axis O; observation angle α (divergence angle); entrance angle β1/β2 (vertical component given first; full range -90° < β1 < 90° and -180° < β2 < 180°; also called illumination angle); angle of rotation ε (origin at the 'TOP' datum mark if marked); angular aperture of the measuring device γ; of the source δ; of the retro-reflecting device η.
The photometry of retro-reflective devices shall comply with the dimensional and physical specifications given in Annex 5 Part 1 para 3 (heading for paras 3.1 to 3.4).
The CIE angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective devices and marking materials.

The CIE co-ordinate system of Figure A4-I shall be realised with a suitable support (goniometer) such as in Figure A4-II, embodying the CIE angular system, with all axes, angles and directions of rotation positive; the principal axis is the illumination axis; the first axis is fixed perpendicular to the plane containing the observation and illumination axes; the second axis is perpendicular to both the first axis and the reference axis; the reference axis is fixed in the retro-reflective device and moved with β1 and β2, its rotation being given by ε.
The goniometer mechanism embodying the CIE angular system shall be as in Figure A4-II, or any equivalent arrangement of the components.
For testing retro-reflection, the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.

The measuring geometry shall be as described in Figure A4-III with the limits: angular diameter of the source δ ≤ 10'; angular diameter of the measuring device γ ≤ 10'; angular diameter of the illuminated area η ≤ 80'.
